description: This file defines the NoteRepository protocol, which specifies asynchronous methods for creating, updating, deleting, fetching, and synchronizing notes in a note-taking app. It outlines the core data operations related to notes, including local persistence and remote synchronization.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title and content, and persists it locally.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note or inserts it if it doesn't exist; marks it as dirty for future sync.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Soft-deletes a note by its ID, marking it for future synchronization.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Loads notes that match an optional search query in title or content, case-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchDirtyNotes
methods.description: Retrieves notes that are marked as dirty or need synchronization.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Integrates remote notes into the local store using last-write-wins based on updatedAt timestamp.
